mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meetings ( host_user_id, title, meeting_type, status, desired_end_at, calculation_version, invite_code ) VALUES ( #{hostUserId}, #{title}, #{meetingType}, #{status}, #{desiredEndAt}, #{calculationVersion}, #{inviteCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT meeting_id, host_user_id, title, meeting_type, status, desired_end_at, calculation_version, invite_code, final_candidate_id, created_at, updated_at FROM meetings WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE meetings SET calculation_version = #{calculationVersion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.meeting_id AS meetingId, m.title AS title, m.invite_code AS inviteCode FROM meeting_participants mp JOIN meetings m ON m.meeting_id = mp.meeting_id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId} AND mp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM meetings WHERE desired_end_at IS NOT NULL AND desired_end_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
mapper.select:
SELECT m.meeting_id AS meetingId, m.title AS title, m.invite_code AS inviteCode, m.desired_end_at AS desiredEndAt, u.nickname AS hostNickname FROM meetings m JOIN users u ON m.host_user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.meeting_type = 'QUICK_VOTE' AND m.status = 'INPUT_OPEN' AND m.desired_end_at IS NOT NULL AND m.desired_end_at > NOW()
AND m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
